plan.title: Yori PH-002: minimal real closed loop (security proxy, constrained Spark reasoning, XMemo OAuth, real providers, demo/submission prep)
plan.source: ARCH-PH002-001 Phase R planning (docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md section 14); execution requires Reviewer approval plus owner gates
plan.description: Slice A security-first proxy hardening first, then constrained Muse Spark reasoning, XMemo OAuth loop (or verified fallback), minimal real providers behind ports, and owner-gated demo/submission preparation. Internal deadline 2026-11-04, external submission 2026-11-05 11:00 JST.

tasks.title: Server-side template registry and structured facts schema for the model proxy
tasks.goal: Replace client-supplied templateWording with {templateId, facts}: prompt text moves to a server-side registry in src/adapters/model keyed by fixed ids; facts validated against a strict schema (bounded arrays/lengths, no extra keys). Unknown id or invalid facts returns 400 with no model call. No src/core/** change (AC-EXT-1 preserved).
checks: Unit tests: unknown templateId, extra facts keys, and oversize strings each return 400 and the upstream model is never called (AC-201-1)
Existing wording flow (D1-D6 scenes) produces identical user-visible output through template ids
python .progress/scripts/emit_convergence_event.py task_complete --task-id A1 --plan-ref docs/architecture/YORI_PH002.plan.json

tasks.title: Proxy guard regression suite and AC-EXT-1 zero-core-diff proof
tasks.goal: Regression-test every PH-001 guard (loopback host, local origin/referer, cross-site, 415/413/429, device-testing isolation) plus prompt-injection fixtures against the new template path, and prove Slice A touched no core file.
checks: Guard suite green: non-local host/origin/referer and cross-site yield 403; non-JSON 415; over-8KB 413; over-rate 429 (AC-201-2)
Injection fixture (facts containing instruction-like text) cannot alter the server-side template or produce uncited facts in output
git diff f43c6c1d -- src/core is empty after Slice A (AC-201-3)
python .progress/scripts/emit_convergence_event.py task_complete --task-id A2 --plan-ref docs/architecture/YORI_PH002.plan.json

tasks.title: OWNER GATE: configure MODEL_API_KEY for Yori (.env.local)
tasks.goal: Owner action: place the Meta model key as MODEL_API_KEY in .env.local (key exists via Muse Code but is not configured for Yori). Executor must not create, copy, or hunt for credentials. If not done, Slice B proceeds on recorded fixtures only and live reasoning stays disabled.
tasks.owner_gate: Owner configures MODEL_API_KEY in .env.local; no credential handling by any agent
checks: Diagnostics endpoint reports enabled only when the owner-configured key is present; the key value never appears in logs, tests, or repo files
If the gate is unmet, record it and continue with fixture-only Slice B (demo unaffected)
python .progress/scripts/emit_convergence_event.py task_complete --task-id OWNER_GATE_1 --plan-ref docs/architecture/YORI_PH002.plan.json

tasks.title: Constrained reasoning port: rank/choose among engine candidates or propose intent
tasks.goal: Extend ModelPort beyond wording: model ranks or chooses among engine-produced candidate plans, or proposes an intent with confidence, over structured facts. Output schema-validated; every claim cites supplied signal/fact ids; uncited or fabricated tokens discard the whole output to the deterministic ranking. PH-002 stays core-free (option a): a model-proposed intent is produced adapter-side as a standard IntentCandidate and enters the EXISTING pipeline entry, so the shared suppression policy applies unchanged with zero src/core/** edits.
checks: Unit tests: a fixture response citing only supplied ids is accepted; responses with uncited claims or invented time/place/price tokens are discarded to deterministic ranking (AC-202-1)
A model-proposed intent suppressed by budget/busy/decline policy never reaches composition (AC-202-3)
python .progress/scripts/emit_convergence_event.py task_complete --task-id B1 --plan-ref docs/architecture/YORI_PH002.plan.json

tasks.title: Recorded-fixture reasoning tests and model-off golden invariance
tasks.goal: All reasoning behaviour is reproducible offline from recorded fixtures/mocks (no live key in CI), and D1-D6 golden outputs are byte-identical with the model disabled, enabled-with-fixtures, and failing.
checks: npm run test:golden and reasoning fixture suites pass with network disabled and no MODEL_API_KEY set (AC-202-2)
Fault-injection (timeout, 5xx, malformed JSON) leaves every golden output unchanged; failures appear only in diagnostics
python .progress/scripts/emit_convergence_event.py task_complete --task-id B2 --plan-ref docs/architecture/YORI_PH002.plan.json

tasks.title: XMemo end-user OAuth existence spike and decision record
tasks.goal: Verify with auditable evidence whether XMemo offers an end-user app OAuth path (registration, scopes, redirect, token endpoints). Deliver a decision record: path exists (with minimal scopes) or does not (with the minimal owner registration action and the fallback demo path). No invented endpoints.
checks: Decision record cites the actual XMemo auth documentation or console evidence inspected; unverifiable claims are marked unverified (AC-203-1)
If no path exists, the record names the single minimal owner action (app registration) and the fallback demo path used by C2
python .progress/scripts/emit_convergence_event.py task_complete --task-id C1 --plan-ref docs/architecture/YORI_PH002.plan.json

tasks.title: XMemo loop with server-side tokens, or fallback demo path
tasks.goal: If C1 finds a path (and the owner completes registration): OAuth sign-in, read preferences, write back confirmed facts only, tokens server-side only, local fallback on any failure. If not: ship the fallback demo path (local adapter as truth; confirmed write-back demonstrated via the agent-side path outside the client) with the limitation stated in DEMO.md.
tasks.owner_gate: Owner completes XMemo OAuth/app registration if C1 finds a path; otherwise owner accepts the fallback demo path
checks: Static proof: no token or secret string exists in client-bundled code; MemoryPort write-back rejects non-confirmed facts (AC-203-2)
With XMemo unreachable or unconfigured, PH-001 memory journeys pass unchanged; whichever path shipped is the one DEMO.md describes
python .progress/scripts/emit_convergence_event.py task_complete --task-id C2 --plan-ref docs/architecture/YORI_PH002.plan.json

tasks.title: First real provider increment: real time and keyless weather behind ports
tasks.goal: Add real clock/time and one keyless/free weather source behind the existing signal ports, each with a mock twin carried within the EXISTING ContextSignal shape (no src/core/** change). Weather queries use a configured fixed demo-city coordinate only; the device geolocation API is never called, and any real device location requires a separate explicit owner gate. Cost (zero) and provider ToS stated in the provider record. Simulated labelling rules unchanged for mock data; real data labelled real.
checks: Provider contract tests pass for both the real adapter (recorded responses) and its mock twin; stale real data triggers the same D6 fail-closed notice (AC-204-1)

Static/config test: no geolocation API reference exists in the provider path and the only coordinates sent are the configured demo-city values; provider record documents endpoint, cost (keyless/free), ToS (AC-204-2)
python .progress/scripts/emit_convergence_event.py task_complete --task-id D1 --plan-ref docs/architecture/YORI_PH002.plan.json

tasks.title: Calendar/route increment gate: consent design only, no default enablement
tasks.goal: Design (not enable) the calendar/route provider increment: consent UX, least-privilege scopes, data-flow inventory. Implementation proceeds only after explicit owner authorization recorded in the task; otherwise the increment stops at the design and PH-002 ships without it (first cut-line item).
tasks.owner_gate: Explicit owner authorization required before any calendar/route implementation or any real GPS/private-calendar data flow
checks: Static and configuration proof: with the gate unmet, no code path transmits real GPS coordinates or private calendar content (AC-204-2)
